remarks: Location, location, location. Completely renovated 3 bedroom / 2.5 bath townhouse in a prime Mid City location. Built in 2017 with high-end finishes, hardwood floors throughout and exquisite trim work. Features exterior Hardie Board siding, Azek trim, beautiful stonework, and landscaping. The open concept main level features an updated kitchen with white shaker cabinets, stainless steel appliances (gas range), quartz countertops and white subway backsplash. The living room / dining room combination is perfect for entertainment and opens up to a balcony that it's perfect to enjoy your morning coffee or evening relaxation. The second level boots 2 spacious bedrooms with plenty of closet space and a full bath. The third-floor primary suite extends to a private rooftop patio with fantastic views of downtown Stamford. Everything imaginable is within walking distance. This end unit includes 2 deeded exterior parking spaces just feet from the front door. This home is the epitome of style, convenience, and prime location. Don't miss out-schedule your private viewing today before it's gone!
